known.title: Isolate the developer’s Claude token from sandbox commands and app API keys
Claude project settings can override the personal-token boundary

findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 2, Harm 4
Raise: Security. The clean launch environment excludes provider credentials and endpoints, but the spec does not address settings that Claude Code loads after launch. A client repo can have a shared `.claude/settings.json` with `env.ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL`; [Anthropic documents](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/settings) that shared project settings apply to sessions in the repo, and [its gateway guide](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/llm-gateway) says a base URL alone routes requests through that gateway while the developer’s subscription remains the active credential. The developer’s token can therefore reach a repo-configured gateway despite the promised credential boundary. Settings-provided gateway credentials or an `apiKeyHelper` can also replace subscription billing. The launch-environment rule does not establish that the developer’s token is used only with Anthropic.
findings.title: Claude project settings can override the personal-token boundary
